title: Sew & Mend🧵 - side project
author: SalivaSpittingWorm
selftext:
I’m working on one big project, but sometimes it wears me out—though that urge to create keeps me going. So I decided to take on a smaller project to give myself a break from the complex mechanics of the big game. This is Sew & Mend. You play as a rag doll who got separated from her owner and ended up in the pocket of a man who picked her up off the ground.

 Of course, the doll wants to get home. It’s a puzzle-platformer where you have to use your fabric-based environment to get where you need to go. But you also have to re-sew your own body to overcome obstacles that can’t be surmounted any other way. I tried to design the game so that each room has several solutions, so that there isn’t just one “right” way to solve it. What do you think?
